title: Conjecture on monochromatic Gower sum and product subspaces
statement: Let $X_k$ be the underlying set of the Gower subspaces, and let $X_k=\bigcup_{i=1}^r C_i$ be a finite partition. A Gower sum subspace is generated by a subset $A=\{\mathbf{n_i}:i\in I\}\subset X_k$, while a product subspace is generated by a subset $B=\{\mathbf{m_i}:i\in I\}\subset X_k$. **Monochromatic Gower subspace conjecture.** For every $k,r\in\mathbb{N}$ and every such partition, there exist subsets $A$ and $B$ such that the Gower sum subspace generated by $A$ and the product subspace generated by $B$ are both contained in the same color class $C_i$. This would unify the additive and multiplicative Ramsey phenomena established separately in the paper, but the combined monochromatic conclusion is presented as a conjecture and its resolution is not supplied here.
source_name: Sayan Goswami, “Additive and multiplicative Gower's Ramsey theorem”, arXiv:2210.16073 (2022).
